a novel problem of provisioning cloud computing services in optical networks with the goal of minimizing the overall energy consumption of the cloud computing system.
the energy-aware provisioning problem in optical cloud networks, which is a critical and challenging problem in the design of green cloud computing systems.
the EPOCN in both dynamic and static traffic cases, which is the first study to the best of our knowledge.
